output.summary: The 19.1-minute group average is a blend. Eight locations sit at a stable 17.6 minutes, set by the October 2024 Made Here redesign. The board knowingly accepted that rise, and the benchmark panel excludes scratch kitchens. Satisfaction, sales, check and food quality all improved since then, so the evidence contradicts group-wide inefficiency. Riverside is a separate local problem. It lost its saute/pasta cook in August, and the 4th line position is still unfilled. Two transfer requests are deferred by group operations, and the KDS shows the delay at that station. Preferred actions are restoring the Riverside position and reframing the benchmark with a per-location alert. Frozen components, a 12-minute bonus and replacing the GM are harmful or unsupported. Why Delgado left remains unknown.
